items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: you mentioned in particular liking Joe H. Lewis's. Yeah.

ctx.x: And I was very impressed by them. I never did hear as much of them as I wanted to.

Uh-huh. Let's see. Now, uh, when you go out and buy 78s or LPs, you mentioned in particular liking Joe H. Lewis's. Yeah. Did you consider that different from, say, King Oliver's Creole Jazz Band or Louis Armstrong and his Hot Five? Did you consider them part of the same tradition or?
Yeah, I did. I wasn't sure what you meant by different. No, as far as I was concerned.
